A drive-thru typically has three points of contact: the speaker where the customer's order is taken, the first window where they checkout, and the second window where they get their order. There will usually be one employee in each position, but the drive-thru cashier or the order presenter can take orders if necessary.

Back drive, aka back cash, is the first window where the customer is checked out. Typically, orders can also be taken in the same position via the speaker.

Window is the second window where the food is handed out by the presenter.
